title: Animal Magnetism
start: Talk to Ava in Draynor Manor.

items.t: Ghostspeak amulet (the reward from completing the hard Morytania achievements will not work)
15 Thieving to pickpocket from a H.A.M. Member or
Obtained from digging at the Varrock Dig Site east of Varrock

recommended.t: Ectophial (requires completion of the Ghosts Ahoy quest)
Activated Canifis, Draynor, Burthorpe, and Port Sarim lodestones
Remora's necklace or skills necklace to get to the Rimmington mine
Slayer ring or any slayer mask to teleport to the Morytania Slayer Tower

rewards.t: Ava's device (Ava's attractor if your Ranged level is less than 50 Ranged or Ava's accumulator if it is 50 or higher)
If you get Ava's attractor and then later get 50 Ranged, you can talk to Ava, who will upgrade it if you give her 75 steel arrows)
Ava's accumulator ammunition pickup passive effect (requires 50 Ranged)
Access to Ava's Odds and Ends

steps.t: Talk to Ava inside the western room of Draynor Manor. [Chat: 1 I would be happy to make your home a better place. › Accept]

sub.t: To get to her room, a candle sconce (North of the entrance) must be pulled.

p: Alice's husband catches the sneaky undead fowl

steps.t: Talk to Alice at the farm west of the Ectofuntus. [Chat: 4 I'm here about a quest.]
Equip your ghostspeak amulet.
Talk to Alice's husband.
Talk to Alice again. [Chat: 4 I'm here about a quest.]
Talk to Alice's husband.
Talk to Alice again. [Chat: 4 I'm here about a quest.]
Talk to Alice's husband.
Talk to Alice again. [Chat: 4 I'm here about a quest.]
Head to Netty's house east of the Slayer Tower.

sub.t: If Vessel of the Harbinger is completed, Netty will be at the Last Call in the City of Um.

steps.t: Unequip the ghostspeak amulet and talk to Netty. [Chat: 2 I'm here about the farmers east of here.]

sub.t: [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Animal Magnetism.'] if at the Last Call.

steps.t: Talk to Netty again to receive the altered ghostspeak amulet. [Chat: 2 I'm here about the farmers east of here.]
Talk to Alice's husband to give him the altered ghostspeak amulet. [Chat: 1 Okay, you need it more than I do, I suppose.]
Talk to him again.
After the cutscene, buy two undead chickens from Alice's husband for 20 ecto-tokens. [Chat: 1 Could I buy those chickens now, then? › 2 Could I buy 2 chickens?]
Talk to Ava in Draynor Manor.
Talk to Helda who is also on the western side of the manor and give her five iron bars.
Talk to Helda again to receive the selected iron.
Take the selected iron to the Rimmington mine.
: You may use the Port Sarim lodestone or the House Teleport spell.
Face north and left click the selected iron to hammer it and make bar magnet.
Talk to Ava.
Attempt to cut an undead tree with a mithril hatchet. Undead trees can be found beside the path that leads you to the entrance.
Talk to Ava.
Go to Burthorpe and talk to Turael (or Spria). [Chat: 3 I'm here about a quest.]
Give them a mithril hatchet and holy symbol. [Chat: 3 Hello, I'm here about those trees again. › 1 I'd love one, thanks.]
Attempt to cut another undead tree with the blessed hatchet until you receive some undead twigs.
Talk to Ava.
Talk to Ava to help her translate the note.
Translate Ava's research notes. The solution is in the image to the right.
Talk to Ava.
Use the pattern with a piece of hard leather and polished buttons to create a container.
Talk to Ava.
Quest complete!

get_inside.text: Draynor lodestone teleport. Run north into the manor grounds.
War's Retreat Teleport. Exit the portal to Draynor and run north.
